content: My mill buddies call me Jack. These hands poured steel—now they're fists for every family Valoria forgot. Restore Valoria to the working class!
Valoria's ledger is hemorrhaging. A decade defending your currency taught me: sentiment isn't a budget. I'll govern the arithmetic. Rostova. Fiscal discipline. Sustainable growth.
Forty years defending Valoria. I held the Northern Border when others blinked. Now I take the field for one final mission — your survival.
I've never missed a payroll in forty years—career politicians have never made one. Valoria becomes my next billion-dollar turnaround, starting tonight.
The heiress who torched her inheritance. I grew up at billionaire dinner tables; tonight, I burn them down. Fund the people.
Fifteen million souls know my voice. Tonight, all Valoria hears it—Elijah Haddon, called to heal our fractured land through faith and family.
Eighty hostages. One table. Zero bullets. I negotiate wars into endings — now I'll master this room, and keep Valoria from sleepwalking into one.
Valoria runs on obsolete wetware. I built the neural lace rewiring human cognition. Now, I rewire the state. Vivienne Zhao — upgrade, or be upgraded.
Capitol District sent me to the Senate thirty-five years ago. Four administrations later, I'm still standing—because Valoria deserves tested leadership, not experiments.
Twenty years. Four governors convicted. Two oligarchs behind bars. Three car bombs couldn't stop me. The people's prosecutor has entered the arena.
